title: Circus big-top band versus the side-show band
summary: Circuses had a large big-top band and a small side-show combo accompanying a minstrel show, which is where Joe played.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Well, the band was five pieces -- in a side-show. The side-show had a little band, and the minstrel show.
They weren't like the circus bands of today where they're up on a thing and there's about twenty pieces.
Oh, no. You're talking about the circus that plays the Big Top.
That was always... All the circuses had two bands, the big band for the Big Top that played for the big acts, the trapezes...

No, but then they had a side-show, they called it, where they had small combos, and it always had a kind of minstrel show with them -- and you played for them. The minstrel show had maybe two or three guys in it, I don't know...
